_comment: What the paper and the diner say when a dealer closes or opens (DealerLifeService), and when a racer shops a
closing-down sale (OpponentLifeService). For the dealers: {dealer} its name, {region} where it is, {blurb} its line
on the map, {discount} the sale's cut in whole percent, {day} a date ({day:dddd} is the weekday: the sale's last
day, or today). For the racers, as in street.json, plus {dealer} and {price}.
The dealer map and lot (dealer.*) say it one way: {dealer}, {discount} and {day} (the sale's last day) as above,
{finalDays} how many days the last, deeper cut runs, {time} the time now.

news.dealer_closing.headline: {dealer} Closing Its Doors
Everything Must Go at {dealer}
{dealer} Calls It a Day
news.dealer_closing.body: {dealer} of {region} is going out of business. Every car on the lot is marked down {discount}% until {day:dddd}, and the prices drop again for the last three days.
After years on the corner, {dealer} is closing down. The whole lot is {discount}% off through {day:dddd, MMMM d}, and the owner says whatever is left by then goes cheaper still.
news.dealer_closed.headline: The Lights Go Out at {dealer}
{dealer} Shuts for Good
lines.news.dealer_closed.body: {dealer} in {region} has closed. Whatever was still on the lot went to the wholesalers.
news.dealer_opened.headline: New Car Lot Opens in {region}
{dealer} Opens Its Doors
news.dealer_reopened.headline: {dealer} Is Back
Lights On Again at {dealer}
lines.news.dealer_reopened.body: The old {dealer} lot in {region} is selling cars again, under new owners and the old name. {blurb}
street.dealer_closing: Word is {dealer} is closing down. Everything on the lot is {discount}% off till {day:dddd}.
{dealer} is going out of business. Get over to {region} before the good ones go.
lines.street.dealer_last_days: Last days at {dealer}: everything's {discount}% off, and it shuts after {day:dddd}.
street.dealer_opened: {dealer} just opened in {region}. Somebody should go and look.
lines.street.dealer_reopened: Somebody opened the old {dealer} lot in {region} again.
lines.dealer.detail.closing: Closing-down sale: {discount}% off every car, and less still in the last {finalDays} days. Last day {day:dddd, MMMM d}.
lines.dealer.detail.closing_final: Closing-down sale: {discount}% off every car, as low as it goes. Last day {day:dddd, MMMM d}.
lines.dealer.lot.sale: CLOSING DOWN · {discount}% OFF EVERYTHING · last day {day:dddd}
lines.dealer.lot.sale_last_day: CLOSING DOWN · {discount}% OFF EVERYTHING · today is the last day
lines.dealer.drive.too_late.title: The doors will be shut
lines.dealer.drive.too_late: Today is the last day of {dealer}'s closing-down sale, and it is {time:h:mm tt}. You would not get there before it shut for good.
street.bargain: {name} picked up a {car} at {dealer}'s closing-down sale for ${price:N0}.
{name} got a {car} for ${price:N0} at {dealer}'s closing-down sale.

{name} bought a {car} off {dealer}'s sale for ${price:N0} just to sell it on.
